title: Excellent neighborhood walking tour
text: Mikael was an excellent guide. He had incredible knowledge about the history of the neighborhoods of Granada. While there is a lot of walking (wear comfortable shoes!), he breaks it up enough where you never feel exhausted. Well thought out routing. Highly recommend!
author: brandon_M

title: Excellent tour with a...
text: Excellent tour with a fantastic guide! We loved learning about the history of the neighborhoods and the city. High recommend. Bring good shoes!
author: Marco_M

title: The tour was a great way...
text: The tour was a great way to understand and experience the core neighborhoods of Granada with an understanding of the history of the city.  And our tour guide Mikael was outstanding.
author: Rory_T

title: One of the best tours of our entire trip
text: This has to be the best tour we did during our 2 weeks in Andalusia!  First off - wear your most comfortable walking shoes.  Second- bring a fully charged camera/phone.  As this is a private tour, our guide was very accommodating in the pace we walked.  He was so knowledgeable about the history and the culture of Granada and the different neighborhoods, so much that I was unaware of.  We climbed up to amazing viewpoints of the city from many different perspectives.  We were lucky enough to stop during the tour for a break with tea and baklavas.  He gave of wonderful suggestions of places to co
author: Debbie_D

title: Outstanding Tour!
text: Mikael gave us a very comprehensive personalized tour of four significant neighborhoods in Granada.  The tour was thoughtfully designed to provide historical and contemporary perspectives while avoiding crowds during high season.  We learned a lot, and the time flew by.  We got great photos with a good understanding of what we were seeing.  Mikael went the extra mile by recommending a flamenco performance and making the reservation for us, then concluding the tour at the meeting point for the flamenco.  He gauged the tour for our stamina (parts of Granada are hilly) and provided rest and a sna
author: tomjacobson

title: Perfect way to get to know Grenada
text: This tour was so informative.  We came to Grenada not knowing much about the history of the people. After this tour we understood the history of the city. The guide was knowledgeable, entertaining, & upbeat.  He took us to areas of the city we would have never found ourself.
author: BridgetC

title: Walk history
text: Our guide was great. He really knew the history of the area. Gave us great tip where to eat and took us to the best tea house!  We really enjoyed the tour and it helped us feel like a local. Thanks!
author: W4990OTtammyl

title: Highly recommended !
text: The best way to get acquainted with the city when you arrive. Extremely interesting guide with a huge culture in many different domains. And on top, very sympathetic ! We really enjoyed !
author: JeanMichel_L

title: The best guide
text:
Mikael, my guide made the tour forever memorable for me.  Knowledgeable, friendly, patient, thorough and a nice guy. 
Of course Granada is spectacular
author: Jeffrey_C

title: 4 neighborhoods
text: We had Sabina as our tour guide.  She was very friendly and accommodating. She had lots of stories to share along the way. We enjoyed our tour. The 4 neighborhoods are beautiful to explore. The stop at the tea shop was nice, too.
